name: Preference-Based Teaching Dimension of the Positive-Teaching Triangle
proof: Put 011 first in the preference order, so it is taught by the empty sample. Among the remaining targets, 110 and 101 are distinguished by one coordinate. Thus a preference-based plan of width one exists; width zero is impossible for a non-singleton class. The exhaustive preference-order calculation is in sync/verify_positive_teaching_triangle.py.
